title: ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 32316, Jan. 4, 2022>
title_original: 환경교육의 활성화 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 32316, Jan. 4, 2022>
Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 6, 2022.
Article 2 (Transitional measures regarding members of committee)
(1) Members of the Environmental Education Promotion Committee commissioned pursuant to subparagraph 2 of Article 5 of the previous Enforcement Decree of the Environmental Education Promotion Act as at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed commissioned as members of the Environmental Education Committee pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 4(2)2. In such cases, the term of office of the commissioned members shall be the remainder of their previous term of office.
(2) If the amended provisions of Article 4(3) are not met as at the time of commissioning members after this Decree enters into force, a specific gender member shall be commissioned until the requirements of the relevant amended provisions are satisfied.
(3) Subparagraph 2 of Article 5 of the previous Enforcement Decree of the Environmental Education Promotion Act shall apply to the composition of the Committee members until the amended provisions of Article 4(3) are satisfied pursuant to paragraph (2).
Article 3 (Relationship to other statutes or regulations)
A citation of any provision of the previous Enforcement Decree of the Environmental Education Promotion Act by other statutes or regulations in force as at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed a citation of the relevant provision hereof, if any, in lieu of the previous provision.
